_provenance.what_this_is: Documentation checklist for a de-identification process. The helper inventories documented human work; it never reads a dataset. Copy it, complete the human review, and escalate every unresolved item to qualified privacy review.
_provenance.status_default: Distributed unresolved by design. Do not paste sensitive information into a template to see whether it passes.
_provenance.reconstruction: Reconstructed from references/privacy_and_disclosure.md, which lists the two HHS methods, the eighteen Safe Harbor categories, the Expert Determination record fields, and the allowed output language.

method.covered_entity_or_association_status: unresolved - the checklist cannot determine this
method.note: The checklist cannot determine whether an organization is a covered entity or business associate, whether information is PHI, or whether a method was correctly applied.

_status_values: generalized - allowed generalization documented and approved
expert_reviewed - addressed under the referenced Expert Determination
safe_harbor_categories._evidence_rule: Every status other than unresolved needs evidence text. Never include an example identifier in evidence.

free_text_review.note: Free text is not exempt and can contain listed identifiers or identifying context.

aggregate_disclosure_review.controls_applied: unresolved - minimum cell thresholds, primary and complementary suppression, category aggregation, top/bottom coding, approved rounding or perturbation, release coordination, query budgets, access controls, secure enclaves, expert review
aggregate_disclosure_review.note: There is no universal small-cell threshold that proves HIPAA de-identification.

escalations_to_qualified_privacy_review: unresolved - list every item escalated; an empty list is not evidence that none exist

output_language.allowed: Documentation checklist complete for the selected method. This output is not a HIPAA compliance or de-identification determination.

boundary_statement: Passing this checklist records a documented human process only. It is not a de-identification determination and not a HIPAA compliance claim. Not for patient care or live clinical use.
